inputs.text: They expect us to swallow the official script about this so-called West Asia conflict, but it is all a staged distraction for the masses while the puppet masters pull the strings behind the curtain. Look at how they trot out former Israeli PM advisor Daniel Rubenstein to spin the narrative, claiming a political resolution is vital for success. That is just coded language for the next phase of their coordinated manipulation! When he emphasizes Israel's unwavering stance against Iran's nuclear and missile programs, calling it an ongoing operation, he is actually exposing the exact timeline of their hidden agenda. They are openly admitting it is an ongoing operation because the elites never intend for it to end; they need the perpetual theater to keep us compliant and distracted from their true coordination at the top.
